title: EP-Governance Transition
description: Schema for a transition record representing a proposed or completed state transition by an agent within the EP-Governance lattice.

id.description: Unique 20-char lowercase base32hex identifier for this transition.

stage.description: Current stage of this transition in its lifecycle.

agent_id.description: XID of the agent proposing this transition.

branch_id.description: XID of the branch this transition operates on.

from_node_id.description: XID of the source node. Null for the first transition on a branch (root node creation).

to_node_id.description: XID of the target node. Should only be set when stage=succeeded.

tool.description: Name of the tool invoked by this transition.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the transition payload, prefixed with 'sha256:'.

action_type.description: The classified action type of this transition.

canonical_resources.description: Canonicalized resource identifiers affected by this transition.

risk_domain.description: The primary risk domain this transition falls under.

classification_method.description: Method used to classify this transition (e.g., rule_based, heuristic, model).

opaque.description: Whether the transition payload is opaque (cannot be inspected).

requires_approval.description: Whether this transition requires approval based on classification.

risk_assessments.description: Object mapping risk domain names to risk assessment objects.

residual_risk_after.description: Object mapping risk domain names to residual risk numbers after mitigation. Null if not yet assessed.

verification_result.description: Result of verifying this transition against policies and risk thresholds.

pulse_trace.description: Trace of the policy evaluation pulse for this transition.

matched_policies.description: Object describing the policies matched during evaluation.

expected_head_id.description: XID of the expected branch head node at the time of proposal. Null for the first transition.

expected_version.description: Expected lattice version at the time of proposal. Null if not applicable.

idempotency_key.description: XID-based idempotency key to prevent duplicate transition submissions.

executor_id.description: XID of the executor that executed this transition. Null if not yet executed.

execution_started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution started. Null if not yet executed.

execution_completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when execution completed. Null if not yet completed.

exit_status.description: Exit status of execution. Null if not yet executed.

result_summary.description: Summary of the execution result. Null if not yet executed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this transition was created.
